_comment: The ORIGINAL Grok prompts that generated the 20 baseline images (provided by the operator). styles.json distills these into scene-agnostic vocabulary; consult these when a style question needs the full source language.

scene.title: SAFE WRITER, LEAKY PRODUCT
scene.caption: A safe writer can still ship an unsafe product.
scene.layout: landscape 16:9, title top, writer+fence+laptop left, arrow center, leaking house+tag right, caption bottom

styles.name: corporate-clean
styles.prompt: Professional corporate presentation slide illustration, landscape 16:9. Clean white background with subtle light gray grid and thin navy header bar. Title at top in bold navy sans-serif. Rounded blue/terracotta pill badges. Simple flat-vector smiling figures. Thick navy outlined arrows with white text. Flat vector, high contrast, PowerPoint-ready, no hand-drawn wobble, generous margins, polished corporate style.

styles.name: dark-executive
styles.prompt: Dark executive presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Deep charcoal navy background with faint geometric lines. Title in large white and gold sans-serif. Glowing cyan / coral-red pill labels. Clean white line-art figures, soft cyan screen glow. Bold gold-outlined arrows with white text. Glowing amber-red liquid reflecting on dark ground. Light gray captions. Premium dark-mode SaaS / board-room style, crisp vectors, high contrast, no clutter.

styles.name: flat-infographic
styles.prompt: Bright modern flat infographic slide, landscape 16:9. Soft off-white background with large overlapping pastel geometric shapes (circle, rounded rectangle) in mint, peach, and sky blue. Bold chunky black title. Sky-blue and peach-orange rounded rectangle cards. Flat icons, no outlines. Oversized coral arrows with white bold text. Kraft tags. Flat design, saturated but friendly colors, startup pitch-deck energy.

styles.name: isometric-3d
styles.prompt: Isometric presentation illustration, landscape 16:9, soft studio lighting on a pale gray-blue background. Title in modern geometric sans-serif. Isometric scenes with mint-green picket-fence enclosures. Blue and terracotta isometric badges. Large 3D isometric arrows with extruded text. Clean isometric vector, soft shadows, presentation-quality, not photoreal.

styles.name: swiss-typography
styles.prompt: Swiss International Style presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Stark white background, strict grid, generous negative space. Massive black grotesk title. Thin black vertical rule down the center. Small blue and red-orange rectangular labels. Highly simplified black-line drawings. Precise black arrows with condensed type. Single line of small black type. Minimal, typographic, no decoration, museum-poster clarity.

styles.name: pastel-notebook
styles.prompt: Soft pastel notebook presentation illustration, landscape 16:9. Warm cream paper background with faint dotted-grid and a few loose colored pencil marks in blush, sage, and butter yellow. Hand-lettered but tidy title in dark brown. Rounded blush-blue and terracotta watercolor badges. Friendly rounded characters. Chunky hand-painted charcoal arrows with cream text. Kraft paper tags. Dark brown rounded caption letters. Gentle, approachable, teacher-workshop / design-thinking style.

styles.name: blueprint-technical
styles.prompt: Architectural blueprint presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Deep blueprint blue background with white grid lines, dimension ticks, and faint compass rose. Title in white stencil / technical lettering. Labeled schematic boxes with small callouts. Technical line drawings. Drafted white arrows with dashed flow lines. Annotation arrows. Cyan-white on blue, engineering drawing aesthetic, presentation-ready, not messy.

styles.name: glassmorphism-saas
styles.prompt: Glassmorphism SaaS presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Soft purple-to-teal gradient background with subtle light orbs. Title in white bold sans-serif with slight glow. Frosted-glass cards with thin white borders and inner blur. Cyan and coral labels. Frosted glass arrows. Frosted caption bar. Polished 2020s product-design look, soft highlights, high-end landing-page slide.

styles.name: newspaper-editorial
styles.prompt: Black-and-white newspaper editorial cartoon presentation slide with limited spot color, landscape 16:9. Off-white newsprint background with faint column rules and a few ink smudges. Bold condensed headline. Boxed captions. Cross-hatched cartoons. Thick ink arrows stamped with text. Italic captions. Classic newspaper cartoon, high-contrast ink, a touch of faded red only on the danger element and its label.

styles.name: brutalist-poster
styles.prompt: Bold brutalist presentation poster slide, landscape 16:9. Hot off-white background with thick black borders and raw stamp-like shapes. Giant condensed black title slamming across the top. Raw cyan and coral rectangle stamps. Thick-marker drawings. Massive black marker arrows with distressed white type. Cardboard tags. Heavy black type. High energy, imperfect print, poster-as-slide, startup all-hands style.

styles.name: consulting-mckinsey
styles.prompt: McKinsey-style consulting presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Off-white background with a thin teal header stripe. Title left-aligned in dark navy serif-sans hybrid. Equal columns with light gray boxed panels and small teal section labels. Simple professional line icons. Thin teal process arrows. Full-width navy insight bar at bottom. Sparse, analytical, lots of whitespace, no decoration, consulting-deck aesthetic.

styles.name: comic-book
styles.prompt: Comic book presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Cream page with bold black panel borders and ben-day dots. Giant comic title in explosive black lettering. Blue and red caption boxes. Cartoon characters. Huge motion-speed arrows with burst text. Drip sound-effect marks. Banner captions. Classic American comic ink, limited bright colors, presentation-ready not chaotic.

styles.name: watercolor-keynote
styles.prompt: Watercolor keynote presentation illustration, landscape 16:9. Textured white paper with loose wet-on-wet washes of indigo, sage, and burnt sienna at the corners. Hand-painted but readable title in dark indigo. Watercolor badges. Loose painted figures. Painted indigo arrows with white lettering. Kraft tags. Dark indigo brush caption lettering. Elegant conference watercolor, not childish, generous white space.

styles.name: chalkboard
styles.prompt: Green chalkboard presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Dark green slate texture with chalk dust and faint erased marks. Title in large white chalk lettering with a slight smear. Chalk boxes. White-and-yellow chalk drawings. Thick white chalk arrows. Orange-brown chalk drips. Bottom chalk captions. Authentic classroom chalkboard look, presentation-clear lettering.

styles.name: paper-cut-collage
styles.prompt: Paper-cut collage presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Warm kraft-paper background with visible fibers. Title cut from black construction paper. Light blue and terracotta paper cards. Cut-out figures, mint paper elements, silver paper details. Layered cardboard arrows with stamped text. Tissue-paper drips. Manila tags. Soft drop shadows under every cut piece. Handmade craft aesthetic, clean composition for slides.

styles.name: retro-memphis
styles.prompt: 1980s Memphis design presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Cream background covered with scattered squiggles, triangles, and confetti in hot pink, teal, mustard, and black. Bold geometric title. Teal and hot-pink squircle badges. Flat characters, zigzag elements. Chunky black-and-pink patterned arrows. Bold captions. Playful postmodern Memphis, slide-readable, not overcrowded.

styles.name: apple-dark-keynote
styles.prompt: Apple keynote style presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Pure black background, ultra-thin San Francisco-like typography. Soft white title in title case. Softly lit 3D objects floating in darkness, gentle rim light. Small muted labels. Simple glowing white arrows with tiny caps text. One quiet line of white text. Minimal, cinematic, huge empty space, premium product-launch aesthetic.

styles.name: sticky-note-workshop
styles.prompt: Design-thinking workshop wall presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Light corkboard / whiteboard background with tape marks. Title on a large yellow sticky note. Blue and pink-orange sticky notes as labels. Sketched drawings pinned with pushpins. Orange sticky-note arrows. Long white sticky note captions. Authentic workshop photoshoot look, tidy enough for a slide.

styles.name: bauhaus-geometric
styles.prompt: Bauhaus geometric presentation poster slide, landscape 16:9. Warm off-white background, primary colors only plus black. Title in strict black geometric sans. Blue and red rectangles with stamped labels. Figures and objects built from circles, squares, triangles; rows of vertical rectangles; heavy black triangle-arrows; drips as vertical bars. Pure Bauhaus: red yellow blue black, no gradients.

styles.name: scifi-hud
styles.prompt: Sci-fi HUD presentation slide, landscape 16:9. Near-black background with faint circuit grid and scanning lines. Title in pale cyan HUD type. Modules outlined in cyan and amber-red with status readouts (ISOLATED / EXPOSED). Wireframe figures. Glowing data-pipe arrows with packet ticks. Warning chevrons and leak particles. Bottom HUD readout. Clean cinematic HUD, readable labels, not cluttered with fake code.
